notes: The source is a domain list, not executable provider code and not an authoritative malicious-domain feed.
PhilthySports must not use entries from this corpus as live sportsbook/provider endpoints.
CI may use the pinned corpus only to flag unexpected .ag domain literals embedded in the release APK.
The upstream repository currently declares no license, so the corpus is fetched read-only at audit time and is not redistributed in this repository.
